correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication in the dihedral presentation shows that noncentral rotations form a clique, reflections commute only in opposite pairs when n is even, and no reflection commutes with a noncentral rotation. This yields isolated reflections for odd n and K_{n-2} disjoint union (n/2)K_2 for even n. The total and paired values then follow componentwise.
